CustomField.description: How old the FEED’s own as-of timestamp may be before FSD 5.9.6 step 2 halts the run. Measured against Sync_Run__c.Feed_As_Of_DateTime__c, never against the Salesforce clock. There is no hardcoded fallback in Apex: if this is unset the run halts.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Halt if the Yardi data is older than this many hours.
CustomField.label: Staleness Tolerance Hours
